{{Quote|You're hanging from a sign.''"<br />"''You're very observant.''"<br />"''I'm programmed to be.|Prowl and Finn Galfridian|<ref name="Invasion 5">[[Invasion 5|''Invasion'' 5]]</ref>}}
'''Prowl''' was a [[Prowler 1000 seeker droid/Legends|Prowler 1000 seeker droid]] that belonged to [[Finn Galfridian]] as of [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]]. After the [[Battle of Artorias]]&mdash;an invasion of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Artorias]], Galfridian's [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]]&mdash;the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] relocated to the [[Jedi Praxeum]] on [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]] with Galfridian. While there, Prowl typically watched his owner [[Jedi training/Legends|train]] until Galfridian, the [[Solo family/Legends|Solo children]], and [[Lowbacca]] investigated a cave where they heard a wounded animal. Prowl was used to investigate the interior of the cave and was confronted by a [[Tuk'ata/Legends|Tuk'ata]], but Prowl managed to escape from harm when [[Darth Caedus|Jacen Solo]] calmed the creature. Prowl later accompanied Galfridian and the other [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] trainees to [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] to help obtain information on a [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]]. After [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] temporarily deactivated Prowl, Galfridian utilized the link in his [[Data goggles/Legends|data goggles]] with the droid to track a [[Dahal|thief]] that led the group to their informant, [[Spraug]]. With their mission successful, Prowl returned to Yavin 4 with Galfridian where the pair attempted to sneak back to Artorias to help fight back against the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] invaders.
